fields.Name: W1 -> S7.3 #2
fields.Description: Gate G5.2 (owner PR 4, phase 5, dataset W1, criterion S7.3): /predict with a renamed feature for a W1-signal s42 model returns 400 naming the feature, and a model with no stored schema is refused, 2 of 2 (T16(b)). The check calls the running truth sidecar's /predict straight: the published W1-signal s42 model's stored v2 artifact with five W1 rows whose EventsAttended column is renamed must be a 400 naming EventsAttended (the unrenamed rows score, 200), and a legacy (v1) envelope built by truthsuite.judges.legacy_envelope sent without a feature schema must be a 400 'no stored feature schema' (with its schema it scores, 200). A v2 artifact stores its own feature columns, so it is never refused for a missing request schema (D4-154).

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Both /predict refusals hold: the renamed feature is named and the legacy model without a stored schema is refused, 2 of 2.
